mandatory_for_derived.rule: Every asset derived from this plate (the defaults frame, the product, shadow and light layers, the throw variants, MBf) gets steps 2 and 3 of THIS plate, so product and wall share the plate's light and black point (RND2). Manager relay, 2026-11-17.
mandatory_for_derived.MP_I1: Step 2, the bed-wall fall-off evening, on the defaults frame and on every layer, before the layers are cut. Use the recorded field (plate-gain-field.png, or the coefficients above), never a refit on another frame. If the frame was generated from raw-tone inputs, apply the field as it is. If it was generated from plate.png (already evened), compare its bed wall outside the product masks with plate.png first: apply the field only where the model put the fall-off back, so the right third (gain 1.1-1.5) is not lifted twice. Then check the layer edges in the right third against the wall around them (FB1).
